project_info.theme: Extreme red cap and hoodie fashion beauty crop
project_info.creative_direction: Tight portrait emphasizing cap embroidery, eyes, fabric stitching, and confident campaign energy
project_info.color_palette: deep red, warm ivory, natural skin, soft brown studio, and subtle shadow charcoal

main_subject.detail: adult female fashion model with eyes and natural facial texture visible beneath the cap brim
main_subject.wardrobe: reference red baseball cap and matching red hoodie with an abstract fictional embroidered mark
main_subject.pose: both hands softly gripping the hoodie collar to create subtle fabric folds

composition_elements.framing: tight crop from nose to forehead, with cap and eyes filling the frame
composition_elements.focus: fictional embroidered mark centered above the eyes, visible stitching and thread depth, clear eyelashes and pores

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft frontal studio light at approximately 4800K with faint cheekbone shadow
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: fabric texture and embroidery clarity, subtle facial sculpting, bold fashion-house campaign mood

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with 100mm macro portrait lens, photoreal fashion beauty crop
technical_specs.finish: ultra-sharp thread detail, natural skin, shallow depth of field, cinematic realism, and no branding overlay

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic fashion beauty crop of a clearly adult woman wearing a reference red baseball cap and matching red hoodie. Frame tightly from the nose to the forehead so the cap and eyes fill the image. Center an abstract fictional embroidered mark above the model's eyes, showing precise stitching and thread depth but no real logo or recognizable brand. Have the adult model grip the hoodie collar softly with both hands, creating subtle fabric folds. Use soft approximately 4800K frontal studio light with faint cheekbone shadows, a warm ivory-to-beige minimalist backdrop, a 100mm macro portrait lens, natural pores, sharp textile detail, cinematic realism, and no text, branding overlay, or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, real logo, trademark, celebrity likeness, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted cap, illegible embroidery
